transcript: Go away! This is Hell's Kitchen. Fires will ignite, stations sabotage, and orders ruin. Burn a dish, you'll burn with it. Work fast and find the imposter among you. Impress me, or I'll find you. Do me a favor and get out.
metadata_caption: I'm BACK on #Roblox in Hell's Kitchen 2 ! Burn the salmon, and you'll burn with it 🔥
